description: This file implements a React component for handling OAuth callback from Confluence within a Next.js application. It manages the display of authorization status and redirects after processing OAuth parameters.

methods.name: ConfluenceOAuthCallbackPage
methods.description: Wraps the inner OAuth callback component within a Suspense boundary for loading fallback.

methods.name: ConfluenceOAuthCallbackInner
methods.description: Handles the OAuth callback processing, displays status messages, and navigates based on OAuth success or errors.
